intro: Malawi is a presidential republic with peaceful transfers of power.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years. Peter Mutharika won the 2025 election, beating Lazarus Chakwera, who accepted defeat.

chapters.title: Courts
text: Malawi's courts have shown independence, including in the 2020 election case.

keyTerms.meaning: To accept that you have lost.
